summary: Bydee is a Sydney-based swimwear and resort wear brand that sells mostly to the US via a dedicated Shopify Plus US store, launched a US warehouse in May 2025 and localised for the UK. Padraig Spillane is Head of Finance (since October 2025) alongside CFO Emma Fisher; he previously ran a month-end close by working day 5 at Hotsprings.

claims.text: LinkedIn lists Emma Fisher as Bydee's CFO and Dessy Hairis as founder and creative director.

hooks.text: US store, US warehouse and UK localisation mean Shopify payouts, FX and inventory-location reconciling each month for a lean team.
Padraig is known for fast closes (working day 5) and has overhauled reconciliations before, so he values rigour and speed.
UK VAT and duties and US tariffs add landed-cost and tax journals.

risks.text: CFO Emma Fisher is based in Lisbon and is the likely sponsor; Padraig joined only in October 2025 so tooling may still be in transition.
Several growth figures come from 2024 coverage and may be out of date.
